reviews.review:
I've put in great deal of time into this game. 2016+hours as of 2016. And i have completed all content other than maxing my mastery, completely free of charge. I've been able to maintain my wealth through trading and if you hate the trade chat there are ways to trade without having to deal with the cancer that is the trade chat. If you get into this game for the first time i recomend watching youtubers that post content on this game so that you can better understand the mechanics.

The only downside to this game i can see is that some content may take a long time to come out. This only affects players like me who have thousands of hours in game. Having done everything and no real need to farm its pretty easy to get burnt out. Though i can say that once you get into the groove of things, really figure things out, nothing quite beats going into an endless mission with a good group of randoms or an organized group and listening to music as you play sipping some coffee.... Very relaxing. 

All in all sorties arn't the best and aid burn out in a way invasions are alright gets useful stuff from them on occasion and stalker sucks buy hunhow's gift once you get some plat to do so or just farm Gal Prime which is easier to get and much better than the weapon that will never drop from that shadowy turd!!...

have fun playing thats what matters the most. find a chill zone and stick with it. and the ingame comunity isn't all that bad either so asking for help generally is no biggs.
